title: Complete-intersection local rings of all scheme-theoretic fibres
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For $s\in S$ let $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ be its scheme-theoretic fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] [def-weil-residue-field]. At a point $y\in X_s$, the fibre complete-intersection condition means that $\mathcal O_{X_s,y}$ is a complete-intersection local $\kappa(s)$-algebra [def-trf-complete-intersection-local-algebra], with scalar action induced by $X_s\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ and the germ map. The morphism $f$ has complete-intersection fibres if this condition holds for every $s\in S$ and every $y\in X_s$. No flatness or local finite type hypothesis is part of this definition. Empty fibres impose no condition, and the empty source is allowed.
